footnote_text: SATS Credit Fund LP entered into a transaction with the Issuer on November 9, 2026 pursuant to which it amended and restated its Senior Unsecured Promissory Note (the "A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note") previously entered into with the Issuer on February 26, 2026. Pursuant to the A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note, the Issuer is obligated to issue to SATS Credit Fund LP 1,500,000 shares of its Common Stock as fees for the facility under the A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note within 15 days of the restatement date, as further discussed in Exhibit 10.5 to the Issuer's Form 10-Q filed on November 10, 2026, incorporated herein by reference. || The reported securities are owned directly by (i) SATS Credit Fund and (ii) Low Time Preference Fund II, LLC, which are private investment funds managed by Ten31 LLC (the "Adviser"), and may be deemed to be indirectly beneficially owned by the Adviser and Jonathan Kirkwood, the co-founder and managing member of the Adviser.
Each American Depositary Share ("ADS") represents eight Class A Ordinary Shares.

SATS Credit Fund LP entered into a transaction with the Issuer on November 9, 2026 pursuant to which it amended and restated its Senior Unsecured Promissory Note (the "A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note") previously entered into with the Issuer on February 26, 2026. Pursuant to the A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note, the Issuer is obligated to issue to SATS Credit Fund LP 1,500,000 shares of its Common Stock as fees for the facility under the A&R Senior Unsecured Promissory Note within 15 days of the restatement date, as further discussed in Exhibit 10.5 to the Issuer's Form 10-Q filed on November 10, 2026, incorporated herein by reference. || The reporting person is the managing member of SATS Credit Fund GP LLC, which is the general partner of SATS Credit Fund LP.
